preconditions.description: The number of objects is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(types) == n and all(t in [0, 1] for t in types)
preconditions.description: The types list contains exactly n elements, each being either 0 (mountain) or 1 (hotel).

preconditions.expression: len(tracks) == n and all(0 <= t <= n for t in tracks)
preconditions.description: The tracks list contains exactly n elements, each being an integer between 0 and n.
There is at least one hotel.

postconditions.description: The path length k is between 1 and n.
The path contains exactly k elements.
All objects in the path except the last one are mountains.
The last object in the path is a hotel.

postconditions.expression: all(tracks[path[i] - 1] == path[i + 1] for i in range(k - 1))
postconditions.description: For each consecutive pair in the path, there is a ski track from the first to the second.
